Sumitomo Mitsui Asset Management Company Ltd decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.15% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sumitomo Mitsui Asset Management Company Ltd sold 13,716 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 421,653 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $70.74M, down from 435,369 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sumitomo Mitsui Asset Management Company Ltd who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $918.49 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.34% or $0.63 during the last trading session, reaching $186.87. About 26.72M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
